text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Trainer <username>.
I had the pleasure of watching your training session!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
That earnest stride, the Trainer's burning passion……
Live lessons are great and all,
but watching this is just as wonderful……!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We backstage crew have to put together an amazing stage to match all their hard work.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry for holding you up.
I'll keep cheering for you!
